turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Look: "eats / Tom / rice / at home" becomes "Tom eats rice at home."
Who? Tom. Action? eats. What? rice. Where? at home.
Rule: who first, then the action, then the thing, then when or where.
Right: Lily drinks milk at night. Wrong: Drinks milk Lily at night.
Your turn. Write one sentence:
Put in order: "plays / Sam / chess / on Mondays"
